title: Record a cash expense
summary: Take money out of the cash register for a small expense (cleaning, stationery, shipping), with its category and receipt.

steps.title: Open the cash register first
steps.details: Movements are recorded in the open cash session: I'll guide you through opening it and then we'll come back.

steps.title: Menu → Cashier → Cashier
steps.details: Today's cash register: opening, movements and closing.

steps.title: Choose the cash register to open
steps.details: Each physical cash register (front desk, another branch) is opened separately. If you already have a cash register open, the others are disabled.

steps.title: Exchange rate
steps.details: Only if the clinic works with two currencies: today's exchange rate to convert between them. It's fetched automatically; you can correct it.

steps.title: Main currency
steps.details: The currency the cash register is kept in.

steps.title: Next
steps.details: Moves on to counting the cash.

steps.title: Count the opening cash
steps.details: How many bills and coins of each denomination are in the cash register when opening; the total shows at the top. «Fill with last closing» copies what was left at the previous closing; «Fill with 0» if the cash register starts empty.

steps.title: Next
steps.details: If there's more than one currency, each one is counted.

steps.title: Review the opening
steps.details: Cash register, user, date, currency, exchange rate and the total counted per currency (with its breakdown).

steps.title: Confirm and open
steps.details: From now on payments, provider payments and miscellaneous movements are recorded in this cash register.

steps.title: Menu → Cashier → Miscellaneous Transactions
steps.details: Money in and out that isn't a patient payment: small expenses, withdrawals, contributions.

steps.title: Category
steps.details: The category defines whether it's an expense (outflow). Example: «Cleaning supplies». Categories are created in Cashier → Product and Services Categories.

steps.title: Payment method
steps.details: Cash moves the cash register's cash on hand; with another method it's recorded but doesn't change the count.

steps.title: Description
steps.details: Example: «Purchase of cleaning supplies for the office».

steps.title: Reference
steps.details: Invoice or ticket number of the receipt.

steps.title: Tags
steps.details: Separated by commas, to group them in reports.

steps.title: Create
steps.details: It stays in the open cash session as an expense (outflow).
